profile.headline: Software Engineer / Data Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Port St Lucie, Florida, United States
profile.summary:
I am an innovative and results-driven Senior Software Integration Engineer with a wealth of experience in data engineering, software development, and implementing scalable integration solutions. With a strong foundation in building ETL pipelines and optimizing data workflows, I focus on ensuring data quality, governance, and compliance across various industries. My expertise extends to developing Multi Page Applications (MPAs) and Webservice and Backend functionality  for Mobile Apps, using modern web technologies and design patterns to deliver seamless user experiences.
Known for my ability to excel in cross-functional collaboration, I leverage Agile methodologies to deliver secure, high-performing software solutions that meet business requirements. Whether working with diverse technical teams or engaging stakeholders to align on integration objectives, I am committed to translating complex requirements into efficient, innovative, and reliable technology-driven outcomes.
I thrive in dynamic environments, continuously adapting to new challenges while maintaining a focus on excellence in integration engineering. I am passionate about delivering software solutions that not only meet user needs but also contribute to long-term organizational success.

Some of my areas of expertise are:
•	Software Integration & Development
•	System Architecture Design 
•	Data Pipeline Construction	
•	ETL Processes  
•	Data Quality Assurance
•	Rapid Technology Adoption	
•	Cross-Functional Collaboration  
•	Data Governance & Compliance 
•	Technical Support & Problem-Solving
My technical proficiencies include:
Software Development Frameworks & Languages:	.NET Framework, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, Ajax, REST API WebServices (via HTTP, Soap, Rest), SnapLogic iPaaS, Python, C#, Visual Basic, Javascript, JQuery, SQL.

Tools & Platforms:	DataGrip, Transmit, Jira, Git, Lucidlink, AirTable, Clubhouse, Code Review, Snowflake, Redshift, Google BigQuery, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, SnapLogic iPaaS, PySpark, AWS Glue, Control-M.

Cloud & Infrastructure:	AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift), Microsoft Azure.
Methodologies & Processes:	Agile Methodologies, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Other Technologies:	Salesforce API.
With a broad technical background and a focus on continuous learning, I am always eager to leverage emerging technologies and contribute to team success through innovative problem-solving and high-impact projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Implementation Engineer - Capital One
positions.description:
Serve as a DealCloud administrator and technical resource for Capital One’s M and A platform, partnering with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into application configurations and automated workflows.
Supported the migration of departmental data from Salesforce to a customized DealCloud implementation, performing data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and go-live support.
Configure fields, layouts, permissions, calculated fields, validations, workflows, dashboards, reports, and templates to support evolving M and A processes.
Design and implement platform enhancements, balancing business needs with platform capabilities, data integrity, usability, scalability, and maintainability.
Develop custom Excel/VBA solutions integrated with the DealCloud Excel Add-In to streamline high-volume data entry, updates, order management, and data synchronization while maintaining DealCloud as the system of record.
Configure and automate processes for temporary coverage, tagging requests, meetings, conferences, and transaction management.
Build Word/VBA solutions integrated with the DealCloud Word Add-In to automate report preparation and formatting for client-facing communications.
Diagnose and resolve complex application, data, reporting, and Microsoft Office integration issues; partner with stakeholders throughout requirements gathering, solution design, testing, and refinement to improve platform functionality and user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · Troubleshooting · Salesforce API · Confluence · Tech-Savvy · Communication · Soft Skills

positions.title: Integration Engineer  - Arizona State University
positions.description:
Design and develop robust data integration pipelines using SnapLogic.
Implement ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to integrate data from various sources.
Ensure data quality and integrity during the transfer process. 
Work closely with data analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data integration needs. 
Provide technical support and guidance on data integration and ETL best practices. 
Monitor the performance of data integration pipelines.
Troubleshoot and resolve any issues related to data integration processes.
Continuously optimize the integration solutions for efficiency and scalability. 
Adhere to data governance and compliance standards.
Implement data security measures in all integration processes. 
Maintain comprehensive documentation of data integration processes and architectures. 
Prepare reports on data integration activities and performance metrics
